name: Healthchecks
description: Cron job monitor that alerts you when a scheduled task stops checking in

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The SQLite database with your checks and their history, and this install's own keys (secrets.env, .admin_password). Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Healthchecks web UI, ping URLs and API, published on host as 6773

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: SITE_ROOT
variables.description: The address you open Healthchecks at. Replace YOUR-SERVER-IP with your server IP, like http://192.168.1.20:6773. The ping URLs your cron jobs call are made from it.

variables.name: SITE_NAME
variables.description: The name shown at the top of the page and in alerts.

variables.name: ADMIN_EMAIL
variables.description: The email you sign in with. Only used when the first account is made.

variables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: The first account's password. Leave it empty and one is made for you: it is shown in the app's logs, in the box marked CREDENTIALS. Only used when the first account is made.

variables.name: REGISTRATION_OPEN
variables.description: Set to True so anyone who can open Healthchecks can sign up (sign-up needs email to be set up).
